headline: Nvidia is reportedly preparing to fire Jensen Huang
summary: Nvidia's board is reportedly moving to dismiss CEO Jensen Huang. This follows a New York Times report on a second alleged extramarital affair. Huang recently admitted to an affair with a suspected Chinese spy.

headline: Hands on with Home Assistant’s new ‘smart home multi-tool’
summary: Home Assistant launched the Connect Aux-2, a new multi-function device. It aims to integrate more non-smart devices into smart homes. This tool is part of Home Assistant's user-friendly expansion.

headline: United won’t let your AI agent book your flight
summary: United Airlines has banned AI agents from booking flights. The airline cites privacy and regulatory concerns for the policy. While rare now, United is preparing for future AI usage.

headline: Loot boxes, influencers, and addictive features face an EU crackdown
summary: The EU proposes a new Digital Fairness Act (DFA) to regulate online platforms. It targets practices exploiting consumers, like addictive features and loot boxes. The act aims to create a fairer online experience across Europe.

headline: Constantine Director 'Hopeful' for Sequel After DC Studios Shakeup
summary: Constantine director Francis Lawrence expressed optimism for a sequel. This hope follows recent leadership changes at DC Studios. Fans have long awaited news on the film's continuation.

headline: Monster Hunter Outlanders Review
summary: Monster Hunter Outlanders is a new mobile spin-off title. It retains the core gameplay and visuals of its console counterparts. However, progress is gated, pushing players towards microtransactions.

headline: The 2026 LEGO Star Wars Advent Calendar Is Discounted at Target After Amazon Sells Out
summary: The 2026 LEGO Star Wars Advent Calendar is now discounted at Target. This comes after Amazon previously sold out of the popular item. Fans can find it while supplies last.

headline: Marvel 1943: Rise of Hydra Is Reportedly 'Close to Done,' Though at the Cost of Cutting Back on Content and Length
summary: Marvel 1943: Rise of Hydra is reportedly nearing completion. The game may face compromises, including reduced content and length. Amy Hennig's Captain America/Black Panther title shows signs of trouble.

headline: Some under-25s should get less benefits, Milburn review to say
summary: A new Milburn review proposes a radical overhaul of the welfare system. It suggests moving under-25s off the main sickness benefits. The plan aims to reform support for young people.

headline: Author says there were 'real concerns' about David Walliams within publishing industry
summary: An author revealed long-standing industry concerns about David Walliams. Concerns involved alleged sexual misconduct, inappropriate behavior, and power abuse. Walliams denies all allegations dating back over a decade.

headline: Clashes erupt in Barcelona after thousands join Spain general strike
summary: Clashes broke out in Barcelona as thousands joined a general strike. The strike was called by major unions over housing and the high cost of living. Demonstrators protested widespread economic grievances.

headline: Hegseth and advisers reprimanded by guard at Tomb of the Unknown Soldier
summary: Pete Hegseth and his advisors were reprimanded by a guard. This occurred at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier after a Veterans Day ceremony. They were reportedly told to be quiet.
